title: Business Strategy Catalogue
description: Catalogue of strategic statements for the Business architecture domain — the what and why at the highest level (outcomes, drivers, target states). Aligned to TOGAF Architecture Vision concepts with OKR-style target outcomes.

meta.description: A catalogue of strategic goals and direction for the Business domain — the outcomes the organisation is trying to achieve and why.
purpose: Aligns leadership on organisational direction before any architecture decisions are made
Provides the 'why' that justifies investment in all other architecture domains
Creates a traceable link between business intent and architecture change
Enables strategy-to-design traceability across the full architecture
Serves as the anchor for assessing whether proposed changes serve the business

statement.description: Strategic statement — outcome-oriented, time-bound where appropriate

driver.description: Business driver or external force motivating this strategy

target-outcome.description: Measurable success criterion (what does success look like?)
